title: End-stop pitch linkage, one blade
description: The pitch linkage as five rigid bodies and their joints, with the two end stops, at 72 degrees blade pitch; no tolerances yet.

provenance.structure_source: Jeff's forge note 20261108T001814_kpoev0 (2026-11-08): 'a new, simpler version of the model, focusing on just the kinematic end stop tolerance', each rigid body a chained stack, 'a single blade, pitch link, and tangential link to start out', and every correct 3D body including the piston cover.
provenance.joints_source: The P2 linkage sweep, data/inbox/linkage-sweeps/vpa-pitch-p2-20261105-204957.json: its geometry.features name ten of this document's nodes by body, under v1's ids, which is why every id here that v1 has is v1's.
provenance.ids: Every node id and every edge id v1 (`vpa_pitch_linkage`) also has names the same feature there; `ids_from` declares it (docs/DAG_TOPOLOGY.md, "Models").

bodies.name: ground: the hub, the two mounts and the piston cover
bodies.note: The piston cover is the base's: its flange sits on the gas-spring mount (`piston_cover_mount_flange_seat`). linkage's base lists the first three parts alone; the difference is declared beside the pairing test.

bodies.name: tangential link
bodies.note: Both bearings are pressed into the 212956-005 assembly, so they move with it; linkage lists the assembly alone because its mesh already draws them -- the difference v1 declares.

bodies.name: pitch plate, gas-spring piston and piston heads
bodies.note: The two piston heads are the plate's: the lower sits on the piston body's shoulder (`piston_body_head_seat`) and the upper stacks on it (`piston_heads_seat`). linkage's pitch plate lists the first two parts alone; the difference is declared beside the pairing test.

notes: Studyless by design for now: M2 adds one term per body and the end-stop study over them (dispatch/docs/strategy/drafts/DRAFT_tolerance_analysis_over_the_kinematic_model.md, '2026-11-08 -- the reset').
No edge carries a dimension. Each says what would close it; an untraced zero would read as a measured one.
Left out, on purpose: the gas spring, the VPA and its piston, the ring gear, the hydraulic brake, every fastener, washer and bushing, and blades 2 to 5. v1 keeps all of them.
